subject: [hw] V19 start: NEON shifts/widening/scalar
body: V19 started (emu/n2a32_neon_shift.c + test_v19). Scope: two regs + shift amount (VSHR/VSRA/VRSHR/VRSRA/VSRI/VSHL/VSLI/VQSHL/VQSHLU, VSHRN/VRSHRN/VQSHRN/VQRSHRN/VQSHRUN/VQRSHRUN, VSHLL/VMOVL, VCVT fixed<->float), three registers of different lengths (VADDL/VADDW/VSUBL/VSUBW/VADDHN/VRADDHN/VSUBHN/VRSUBHN/VABAL/VABDL/VMLAL/VMLSL/VQDMLAL/VQDMLSL/VMULL int+p8/VQDMULL), two regs + scalar (VMLA/VMLS/VMUL int+float, VMLAL/VMLSL/VMULL/VQDMLAL/VQDMLSL/VQDMULL/VQDMULH/VQRDMULH). Exact routing proposal posted to V02 (the current op5 test misroutes V19 encodings with D=1/size=3/Vn<3>=1 to V20). I will use c->fpscr bit 27 for QC, per work_packages V18 and n2a32.h; please tell me if V17/V18/V20 use a different convention.
